briefing.title: THE KEY
lines: Forty years ago the Meridian Combine walked out of this valley and left one machine running. The Reclaimer. A harvester the size of a district, with one order: reclaim all material.
It is still obeying. It strips the yards to bare earth and hauls everything to the Crucible, where it melts into ingots nobody will ever collect.
Last night you took the Combine's shutdown key off a dead foreman. The Reclaimer felt it go. It follows the key now.
Three free machines. Three yards. Carry the key to the Crucible before it catches you.
briefing.bay_text: Three frames on the lifts and a bench of basic parts. Build the crew that will carry the key.

acts.name: THE CRANE YARDS
acts.mission: Reach the Sorting Gate. The Reclaimer follows the key.
acts.boss: The Sorting Gate, and the Sorter that keeps it, shielded by the gate's pylons. Through it is the next yard.

acts.name: THE SLAG FLATS
acts.mission: Cross the flats to The Pour. The slag is still warm.
acts.boss: The Pour: the Slag Flats' keeper, flooding the floor under the crew. Through it is the Crucible.

acts.name: THE CRUCIBLE
acts.mission: Into the furnace-city. The key goes into the Core.
acts.boss: The Core: the Crucible's heart, bolted to the floor and pulsing. Turn the key in it and the Reclaimer stops.

sites.start: The crew's camp. The Reclaimer's dust is already on the horizon.
sites.skirmish: Spiked rigs, working for the Reclaimer. Beat them for scrap and their parts.
sites.elite: A heavy spiked rig and its escort. One of its parts is worth having.
sites.scrapyard: A heap the Reclaimer has not reached. Take one part, or strip it for scrap.
sites.workshop: A Combine service hall with the lights still on. Repairs, rebuilds, room in the hold.
sites.boss: The Sorting Gate, and the Sorter that keeps it, shielded by the gate's pylons. Through it is the next yard.
sites.trader: A free trader in a container, lamps on. Parts for scrap, and scrap for your spares.
sites.tower: A crane cab still standing. From up there the fog is thinner.
sites.signal: Something out here is sending. Worth a look, maybe.
sites.warlord: A Reclaimer warlord holds this ground with its own rule. Its hoard is worth the detour.
sites.refinery: A Combine refinery with one furnace still banked. Feed it a part and something better comes out.
sites.auction: Free machines selling salvage they never opened. You pay first.
sites.arena: A ring of barriers and spiked rigs that fight for the Reclaimer's amusement. Win, and the pot is yours.

endings.won: The key turns in the Core. Behind the crew the Reclaimer's booms sag and go still, one district at a time, and the valley is quiet for the first time in forty years.
endings.gate_held: The gate held. The crew had nothing left to break it with, and the Reclaimer closed in behind.
endings.wrecked: The Reclaimer took the crew. Somewhere in the Crucible, the key melts with them.
